video_title: Perk Had a LOT to Say About His Viral 2K Rating

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins disputes his 2017-2018 NBA 2K rating with the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: The nerve of you to disrespect me like that on that squad.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Ronnie 2K, you go fuck yourself. The nerve of you to disrespect me like that on that squad. First of all, they gave you a rating. I don't think I've ever seen a 17 rating. It's fine. I think he wanted a response from me because the text messages, Ronnie, that you've been blowing me up about before the game, I feel like there's something to it.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: You made a 17 for a you rebound.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins reflects on his 2018 NBA Finals performance
quotes.excerpt: When I got injured, they couldn't finish. Couldn't complete the mission in Game 7 up 14.
quotes.quote: When I got injured, they couldn't finish. Couldn't complete the mission in Game 7 up 14 on the biggest stage. All I know is, when I left those guys, they didn't get back to the finals. I did, with a whole different team.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Channing Frye discuss 2K ratings for historical teams
quotes.excerpt: Jefferson is a low 80s. You got to be a low 80s.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Yo, do you not remember the video? They did a guy. We'll clip it. This guy was like, I'm playing against the 2016 Cavs and look at these guys. They got Kyrie at 98, LeBron at 99, J.R. at 87. Jefferson is a 75. Jefferson is a low 80s. You got to be a low 80s.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Wait, in prime? In my prime? Yeah, low 80s. Like an 83.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson questions his 2K rating fluctuations
quotes.excerpt: How was I a 74 and then when I was averaging five a game, but then when I was averaging 20 a game, I'm an 82?
quotes.quote: How was I a 74 and then when I was averaging five a game, but then when I was averaging 20 a game, I'm an 82? The best thing that 2K ever did was just rating to get people to talk about it.
